race.comment: ANOTHER CASHIE (2) is the one to beat after tackling stronger company at Eagle Farm, where he was a beaten favourite but was still good to the line despite pulling up slow to recover. Inside draw looks a touch sticky but the rise in trip suits third-up and if the gap appears he will prove mighty tough to stop. MEET GEORGE (3) is the main danger, also dropping back from Saturday racing and returns to a winning trip third-up. Newman's 2kg claim gets him in well at the weights and the draw should have him blending in at the right time. Great chance to break the drought. BRUMAL (8) was a sharp improver here second-up when in the placings, adding to the maiden win here from his debut prep. Strips fitter on the quick back-up and gets the key booking of Thompson. Win won't shock. KEEP IT REAL (1) has been thereabouts in his two runs and has more to offer third-up with the blinkers going on first time.
